brand.name: WhereIsTheBin
meta.description: Find nearby public bins and authorised waste facilities across Kerala, in English and Malayalam.
home.title: Find the right bin, right where you are
home.lead: Public bins, collection centres and recycling points across Kerala, with what each one accepts and when it was last checked.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how.1.title: Find
home.how.1.text: Share your location or type a place name.
home.how.2.title: Check
home.how.2.text: See what each place accepts and when it was last verified.
home.how.3.title: Go
home.how.3.text: Get walking directions and dispose responsibly.
home.types.title: Not every place takes everything
home.types.text: We keep each kind of facility separate, so you know what you are walking to.
home.contribute.title: Know a bin that is not on the map?
home.contribute.text: Add it for review. New places appear as verified only after a moderator checks them.
footer.note: WhereIsTheBin is a community information service. It is not a waste collection agency. Accepted materials and access rules vary by facility.
